name: webknossos
description: Work with WEBKNOSSOS datasets and annotations through the WEBKNOSSOS Python library.
long_description: Connects Claude to a WEBKNOSSOS instance. Provides a short-lived API token for the signed-in user and the documentation of the WEBKNOSSOS Python library, so that Claude can write and run Python code against your datasets and annotations instead of calling the HTTP API by hand.

tools.name: get_short_lived_api_token
tools.description: Creates a short-lived WEBKNOSSOS API token for use with the WEBKNOSSOS Python library.

tools.name: list_python_library_docs
tools.description: Returns the index of the WEBKNOSSOS Python library documentation.

tools.name: read_python_library_docs_page
tools.description: Returns one page of the WEBKNOSSOS Python library documentation.

url.title: WEBKNOSSOS MCP URL
url.description: The MCP endpoint of your WEBKNOSSOS instance, e.g. https://webknossos.org/api/mcp

token.title: Auth Token
token.description: Your WEBKNOSSOS API token, from Account Settings > Developer > Auth Token
